description: Find U.S. healthcare providers within a radius of a ZIP code or coordinate, from CMS NPPES data. Provide either "zip", or both "lat" and "lng". Distance is measured from each provider's primary practice location to the ZIP centroid (not an exact street address), since NPILayer's geography is ZIP-based.

entity_type.description: Restrict to individual providers or organizations, e.g. to exclude group practices from "find a cardiologist" results.

taxonomy.description: An exact NUCC taxonomy code, e.g. "207RC0000X".

zip.description: A 5-digit ZIP code to search around.

name: providers_near
title: Find providers near a location
